function setState()
{
if(flickableAreaMaxHeight >= settingFlickableArea.contentHeight){
if(isMovingUp){
edgeImagesState.state = "TopEdgeOn"
}else if(isMovingDown){
edgeImagesState.state = "BottomEdgeOn"
}else{
edgeImagesState.state = "EdgeOff"
}
return
}
if(settingFlickableArea.atYBeginning &&(isMovingUp || settingFlickableArea.movingVertically)){
edgeImagesState.state = "TopEdgeOn"
}else if(settingFlickableArea.atYBeginning && !isMovingUp && !settingFlickableArea.movingVertically){
edgeImagesState.state = "EdgeOff"
}else if(settingFlickableArea.atYEnd &&(isMovingDown || settingFlickableArea.movingVertically)){
edgeImagesState.state = "BottomEdgeOn"
}else if(settingFlickableArea.atYEnd && !isMovingDown && !settingFlickableArea.movingVertically){
edgeImagesState.state = "EdgeOff"
}else{
edgeImagesState.state = ""
}
}
function onReleased()
{
isMovingUp = false
isMovingDown = false
firstPressedPositionY = -1
setState()
}
function pressedYPosition(posY)
{
firstPressedPositionY = posY
}
function movingYPosition(posY){
if(firstPressedPositionY === -1){
isMovingUp = false
isMovingDown = false
return
}
if((firstPressedPositionY - posY)< 0){
isMovingUp = true
isMovingDown = false
}else if((firstPressedPositionY - posY)> 0){
isMovingUp = false
isMovingDown = true
}else{
isMovingUp = false
isMovingDown = false
}
setState()
}
